name: thai2d3d-desktop
description: Native desktop wrapper (Windows .exe + Linux .AppImage) for the Thai2D3D web app.
author: Thai2D3D

scripts.dist: npm run dist:linux && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/prepare.js linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config.directories.output=dist/standalone-linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/download-php-win.js && node scripts/prepare.js win && electron-builder --win portable --config.directories.output=dist/standalone-win --publish never
